messages:
alex.p: Heads-up — incoming pen test next week. We need a quick checklist for evidence sanitization and a retest rhythm. Who can own packaging and RBAC gating?

mira.s: I can take packaging. plan: presigned S3 + read-only access, scrub PII, strip API keys. Need guidance on KMS-wrapped artifacts though.

samir.k: For KMS, use envelope encryption: artifacts encrypted with a data key, data key wrapped by our KMS CMK. Provide only unwrapping to assessor role for the time window via ephemeral role.

olivia_r: +1. Also add audit logging guidance: enable object-level logs + KMS decrypt events in CloudTrail. We should snapshot logs to a retention bucket and share digest with assessors.

alex.p: Good. Mira — can you outline the sanitization steps? Minimal manual work, reproducible.

mira.s: Sure — rough flow: 1) run automated scanner to detect secrets/CIDs, 2) remove or redact lines with tokens, 3) canonicalize timestamps, 4) generate sanitized diff and hash, 5) encrypt artifact and upload. I'll post a short script.

samir.k: For RBAC: create an assessor role with a session policy that grants s3:GetObject on the presigned objects and kms:Decrypt on the wrapped data key, time-limited. We must log role assume with STS - include request tag with assessment-id.

olivia_r: Ops asked about ephemeral windows length. Recommend 4-hour windows per assessor with a single renewal allowed. Document the restart procedure if assessor hits a blocking bug.

security-bot: NOTE: Reminder — create Jira ticket SEC-PT-2026 with artifact manifest and ACL snapshot before granting access.

alex.p: For remediation tracking: we'll use the existing vuln-triage board but add a "pen-test evidence" column. Each fix must reference the artifact hash and sanitized diff. Also include rollout plan and telemetry checks.

mira.s: Re: retest rhythm — propose triage within 48h of report, patch sprint within 7 days for critical/high, validation retest slot request after patch deployed. We should batch low/medium into weekly retest windows.

samir.k: Can we reserve two retest slots daily for the engagement (morning/afternoon)? If capacity constrained, fallback to a queued schedule and inform assessors via calendar invite.

olivia_r: I'll coordinate with Dedicated infra to lock small GPU windows for simulated load testing during retest. Also adding a checklist to ensure feature flags are set to route traffic to staging.

alex.p: Communication plan: use this thread for ops triage, create a read-only #pt-status channel updates for execs, and @assessors in direct threads for role handoffs.

mira.s: I'll drop the sanitization script and an example presigned URL command in the ticket by EOD.

samir.k: I'll produce the IAM trust policy template and ephemeral role TTLs.

olivia_r: I'll schedule two retest slots and add calendar invites with the requirements.

alex.p: Thanks team. If anything blocks, escalate here. :thumbsup:
